questions.text: How long have you been feeling unusually tired or weak?
questions.purpose: Characterise onset and duration of anaemic symptoms

questions.text: How severely does fatigue affect your daily activities?
questions.purpose: Grade fatigue severity to guide urgency
options: Mild – I can do most things
Moderate – I have to cut some activities
Severe – I struggle with basic tasks

questions.text: Do you feel short of breath or have chest pain at rest or with minimal exertion?
questions.purpose: Identify severe symptomatic anaemia requiring urgent escalation

questions.text: Have you or anyone else noticed that your skin, gums, or inner eyelids look pale?
questions.purpose: Confirm clinical pallor as objective sign of anaemia

questions.text: Do you notice your heart racing or pounding (palpitations) even when resting?
questions.purpose: Detect compensatory tachycardia from significant anaemia

questions.text: Have you had any recent blood loss — such as heavy periods, blood in your stool, vomiting blood, or a known bleeding source?
questions.purpose: Identify blood-loss anaemia and direct toward source investigation

questions.text: Do you follow a diet that excludes or greatly limits meat, fish, or dairy products?
questions.purpose: Screen for nutritional deficiency as a cause (iron, B12, folate)
